# langsmith_run_rule (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a LangSmith automation rule by ID or display name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_run_rule" "example" {
  display_name = "my-automation-rule"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) The display name. Either `id` or `display_name` must be specified.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier. Either `id` or `display_name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `alerts` (String) JSON-encoded alerts.
- `backfill_from` (String) Backfill start timestamp.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `evaluators` (String) JSON-encoded evaluators.
- `filter` (String) Run filter expression.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `sampling_rate` (Number) The sampling rate.
- `session_id` (String) The project/session ID.
- `trace_filter` (String) Trace filter expression.
- `tree_filter` (String) Tree filter expression.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `webhooks` (String) JSON-encoded webhooks.
